# Indie Block Records

> Mixing and mastering studio for independent musicians in Austin, Texas, priced per track. Clients upload stems; mixes come back for two rounds of notes; streaming and vinyl-ready masters are delivered as WAV files.

- Rates (USD): mix $180 per track; master $60 per track; mix + master $220 per track; EP bundle of 5 tracks mix + master $990; vinyl-ready master $120 per side; extra version (instrumental/clean) $25.
- Not offered: distribution or streaming uploads, promotion, royalty handling, session musicians.
- Contact: mix@indieblockrecords.com
